title: Psychiatric care in prison: Quasi-experimental evaluation of treatment on the general psychiatric ward in Neumünster prison
summary: Inhaftierte Personen sind häufiger von psychischen Störungen betroffen als die Allgemeinbevölkerung. In Schleswig-Holstein erfolgt die stationäre Versorgung behandlungsbedürftiger Gefangener durch die psychiatrische Abteilung in der JVA Neumünster. Die geplante Studie untersucht den von den Patienten empfundenen Effekt dieser Behandlung.

interventions.name:
Intervention group: Sequentially admitted male prisoners, that receive treatment as usual on the general psychiatric ward in Neumünster prison
(Treatment weekly includes: 1 contact with a doctor, 1 individual session of psychotherapy, 2-3 group sessions of psychotherapy, 1 contact with assigned pri
Passive control group (no intervention): Psychologically strained male prisoners (on remand and sentenced) from regular prison units of the same prison

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patient on the psychiatric ward (intervention group) or prisoner, sentenced or on remand, on another ward (control group), in Neumünster Prison
Exclusion criteria:
- Lack of language skills
- Intellectual disability
- Severe mental symptoms (e. g. acute suicidality, florid psychosis) where self-report is unreliable or contraindicated
- Remaining prison sentence < 6 weeks
